# A pickup sparkle. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Spark --base-color 1.000 1.000 1.000 --no-slot
add mesh cube --size 1 --name A --location 0 0 0
scale 0.6 0.06 0.08
apply --scale
apply --location
material assign Spark
add mesh cube --size 1 --name B --location 0 0 0
scale 0.08 0.06 0.6
apply --scale
apply --location
material assign Spark
add mesh cube --size 1 --name C --location 0 0 0
scale 0.32 0.06 0.06
apply --scale
set rotation 0 45 0
apply --rotation
apply --location
material assign Spark
add mesh cube --size 1 --name D --location 0 0 0
scale 0.32 0.06 0.06
apply --scale
set rotation 0 -45 0
apply --rotation
apply --location
material assign Spark
select A B C D
active A
join
rename A Pop
select all
shade flat
export pop.glb
